input: Three same-date Production-authorized Research Objects, the exact generated Production prompt v2.13.0, and all 13 required sources fetched and verified from Worker Claim main commit 328c47b1ca0bb67fafbe0a75ff02736d180dfbdd. Direct SHA-256 over the prompt bytes matched CONTROL and MANIFEST.
input_zh: 输入为三份归属 2026-09-14 且已授权生产的研究对象、精确的生产提示词 v2.13.0，以及从 Worker Claim main 提交 328c47b1ca0bb67fafbe0a75ff02736d180dfbdd 读取并核验的全部 13 项必需来源。直接计算提示词字节的 SHA-256，与 CONTROL 和 MANIFEST 完全一致。
workResult: Converted all three authorized Research Objects into complete bilingual Editorial Architecture 2.1 candidates with nine planning artifacts and three deterministic baseline covers. Two bounded revision rounds replaced unregistered article types and repaired Chinese technical-term introductions and prose density. The atomic candidate bundle, checkpoint, layout, editorial, Chinese-language, Runtime V5, prompt/control, recovery, continuation, terminal, bridge, bundle, intelligence, and scorecard gates passed.
workResult_zh: 将三份已授权研究对象转换为完整双语编辑架构 2.1 候选，包含九项策划工件与三张确定性基础题图。两轮有界修订完成未注册文章类型替换，并修复中文技术术语首次解释及英文密度问题。原子候选包、检查点、布局、编辑、中文语言、Runtime V5、提示词与控制、恢复、续跑、终态、桥接、候选包、情报和评分卡门禁全部通过。
output: Three complete bilingual publication candidates, six canonical article files, three deterministic baseline covers, and a completed validators-passed checkpoint with every item Ready.
output_zh: 三篇完整双语发布候选、六个正式正文文件、三张确定性基础题图，以及所有条目均为 Ready 的 validators-passed 完成检查点。
next: Publication remains a separate governed task and was not executed.
